verdict.rationale: Bugbot is documented exclusively as a PR-comment-triggered reviewer integrated with GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps, posting inline PR comments — there is no mention of a CLI, local-diff scanning, or machine-readable (JSON/SARIF) output for CI script consumption anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: any CLI binary/command, local diff support, structured/machine-readable output format, or CI-script-oriented API.
